name: Mounting Hole Planner
blurb: keep-out on the board from hole size, standoff and screw
intro: The drill, pad and keep-out rings around a mounting hole from the screw, its head or washer and the standoff under it. Clearance holes are ISO 273 (metric) or the close/free-fit drill chart (inch); head and washer sizes are the ISO / ASME nominal maxima.

inputs.label: Head
options: No head on this side (nut / standoff only)

inputs.label: Standoff size (AF or OD)
inputs.help: Leave empty for the usual size for the screw.

inputs.label: Copper clearance
inputs.help: Gap from the metal (head, washer, standoff) to other copper.

inputs.label: Tool / part margin
inputs.help: Extra room all round for the screwdriver or nut driver and for part tolerances.

examples.title: M3 pan head on a 5.5 mm hex standoff, isolated

usage: Pick the screw (M2-M6 or #2-56/#4-40/#6-32), the clearance class, head type, washer and standoff; sizes in mm. It returns the drill diameter, the pad diameter for a plated hole, the copper keep-out and component keep-out diameters, and the minimum distance from the hole centre to the board edge. Use it when placing mounting holes or making a mounting-hole footprint.
sources: ISO 273 clearance holes for bolts and screws
Machinery's Handbook close / free fit drill chart (inch screws)
